svg.text: Rectangle = entity | Diamond = relationship | Oval = attribute | Underline = primary key | (FK) = foreign key | Dashed oval = derived
(min,max) is the number of relationship instances per entity instance. Double line = total participation; single line = partial participation.
SCHEME_CATEGORIES: composite PK (scheme_id, category_id). APPLICATIONS: UNIQUE (user_id, scheme_id).
USER_PROFILES.user_id and SCHEME_EMBEDDINGS.scheme_id are UNIQUE. changed_by and parent_category_id are nullable.
Applications may have zero log records. Category CHECK prevents self-parenting; the supplied DDL does not prevent multi-category cycles.
Eligibility evaluation: AND within a rule group; OR between groups. age is derived from date_of_birth at the eligibility reference date.
